original_manifest.protocol: One short paired screen: phase CDEF secondary taps by distance to remove spills, retaining hoisted signed rounding shifts outside 8/4-wide row loops. Warm public Reset+DecodeNext at workers=1. Target p720_inter_q32 >=0.5% paired geometric-mean saving and >=2/3 faster pairs; control p360_intra_q32 <=1% regression; all warm rows zero allocations. Three alternating pairs, all observations retained. No retry or pooling. No native-gap claim.

all_actual_rows_and_audit.protocol_deviation: The Go -test.bench pattern was split at slashes. The clip component p720_inter_q32 lacked its own end anchor, so every intended p720 process also ran p720_inter_q32_2tiles afterward. Original raw logs and manifests remain unchanged. Acceptance used only the predeclared exact p720 and intra rows. Accidental two-tile rows are disclosed here and do not substitute for the target gate. No new timings were collected.

rejected_cdef.correctness: Focused SIMD random/strength/sentinel/clip/unit/U8 parity and zeroalloc passed; source-derived libaom corpus passed; decoder U8 whole/banded and native HBD snapshot passed. V1 experiment-off U8 test and both amd64 SIMD crossbuilds passed. No acceptance based on compiler diagnostics alone.

limitations: Three pairs are a small screen, with no interval or whole-corpus speedup claim.
p360 intra is an affected comparison case, not an inactive control; its point estimate regresses 0.5273%.
The regex deviation added six two-tile rows. All eighteen actual rows are preserved; extra outcomes are descriptive only, and original target selection is unchanged.
One-minute host load at process end ranged from 14.70 to 19.58; coordinated agent CPU work was paused but unrelated host work was not controlled.
Earlier E/I/H setup does additional unused work for groups that fall back to scalar kernels.
No new race/full-worker matrix or native performance campaign was run. No allocation or memory-reduction claim.
